items.title: Paris court annuls Sotheby’s sale of Pissarro painting
items.brief: A French court has annulled a Sotheby’s sale of a Camille Pissarro painting and ordered the auction house to help the descendants of the artwork’s original Jewish owner.

items.title: Wholesale inflation rose in October to highest annual rate in nearly four years
items.brief: The cost of doing business in the US is getting increasingly pricier: Wholesale-level inflation accelerated last month to its highest rate in nearly four years, Bureau of Labor Statistics data showed Friday.

items.title: Manchester United hires Mauricio Pochettino as its new head coach, US set to begin search for replacement
items.brief: Mauricio Pochettino has been confirmed as the next head coach of Manchester United, the team announced on social media on Friday.

items.title: Grief reverberates through this church near the deadly Brooklyn collapse
items.brief: Leonor Yupa dropped to her knees Thursday when a Spanish-language media reporter said her 22-year-old son was among eight people whose lives were claimed by the Brooklyn building collapse the day before.
